notes: Live streaming (B1): open a 1:1 chat and tap the broadcast icon to go live for one viewer. Media is relayed through the server TURN relay (never peer-to-peer); the viewer is receive-only, and the broadcaster can mute or turn the camera off mid-stream. Also fixes the Windows crash on app close caused by disposing the WebView2 environment after the plugin channel had already shut down. Note: this build corrects the version constants, so the app no longer reports 1.0.41 or prompts to reinstall 1.0.42 on every launch.
